# Quarantined flaky Delta-on-Gluten tests.
#
# These tests fail NON-DETERMINISTICALLY under the Gluten Velox bundle: the same
# byte-for-byte bundle passes them on one CI run and fails them on the next. They
# therefore cannot live in known-failures.txt -- baselining them turns the gate
# red on every run where they PASS (fail-on-fixed), while leaving them out turns
# it red on every run where they FAIL. The Delta Spark UT (Gluten) gate treats a
# quarantined test as NEUTRAL: it never counts as a regression when it fails, nor
# as now-passing when it passes, and it is excluded from the regenerated baseline.
#
# Format: <suite-glob>#<exact test name>. The SUITE part is an fnmatch glob so a
# single line covers a root-cause family across generated suite variants (e.g.
# `*DVs*Suite` = every deletion-vector merge suite); the TEST name is matched
# exactly. Lines starting with '#' are comments.
#
# Prefer fixing the underlying bug and REMOVING the entry over growing this list.
# Every entry should reference a tracking issue for the root cause.
#
# NOTE: when a bug surfaces on a DIFFERENT test each run (so matching by name is
# whack-a-mole), quarantine it by ERROR SIGNATURE in flaky-error-patterns.txt
# instead.

# Timing-sensitive: the test gives an AvailableNow-triggered CDC stream 10s to
# terminate (query.awaitTermination(10000L)). With 4 forked JVMs near the runner's
# memory limit, the batch can still be in Gluten's Parquet metadata validation
# (ParquetMetadataUtils listing files via RawLocalFileSystem, which forks `ls` per
# file for permissions), so it times out. Failed once in 25 runs, on the
# Velox-bump PR #13418 (run 39902045267), which changed no Java code.
org.apache.spark.sql.delta.DeltaCDCStream*Suite#maxFilesPerTrigger with Trigger.AvailableNow respects read limits
